sentences.zh: 正西有銅鞮水，有二流，一名小漳河，一名西漳河，下流入襄垣縣，合濁漳水。

translations.literal: Due west has Tongdi River, has two flows, one name Little Zhang River, one name West Zhang River, lower flow enters Xiangyuan County, joins Zhuo Zhang River.
translations.idiomatic: Due west is the Tongdi River, which splits into two branches—the Little Zhang and West Zhang rivers—flowing down through Xiangyuan County to join the Zhuo Zhang River.

translations.literal: Administered two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties.

sentences.zh: 西北距布政司三百十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from provincial commission three hundred ten li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred ten li northwest of the provincial administration commission.

translations.literal: Qinyuan zhou west slightly south.
translations.idiomatic: Qinyuan zhou—west and slightly south [of the prefecture].

sentences.zh: 北有綿山，沁水出焉，經縣東，下流至河南修武縣入大河，行九百七十餘里。

translations.literal: North has Mian Mountain, Qin River issues, passes east of county, lower flow to Henan Xiuwu enters Great River, runs nine hundred seventy-odd li.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Mian Mountain, whence the Qin River flows east of the county; it reaches Xiuwu in Henan and enters the great river—a course of more than nine hundred seventy li.

translations.literal: Also north has Mianshang Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Farther north is the Mianshang patrol inspectorate.

translations.literal: Wuxiang zhou northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxiang zhou—northeast [of the prefecture].

sentences.zh: 西有涅水，又西有武鄉水入焉。

translations.literal: West has Nieshui, also west has Wuxiang River enters it.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Nieshui; the Wuxiang River joins it from farther west.

translations.literal: Liao Prefecture Yuan belonged to Jinning Route.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Prefecture under the Yuan belonged to Jinning Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武初，以州治遼山縣省入。

translations.literal: Hongwu early, with seat Liaoshan County abolished merged in.
translations.idiomatic: In early Hongwu the seat county Liaoshan was abolished and merged in.

translations.literal: Second year directly subordinate Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 it was made directly subordinate to the Branch Secretariat.

translations.literal: Ninth year directly subordinate Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 it was made directly subordinate to the provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 東南有太行山，洺水所出，上有黃澤嶺，嶺有十八盤巡檢司。

translations.literal: Southeast has Taihang Mountain, Mok River issues, atop has Huangze Ridge, ridge has Eighteen Bends Patrol Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast is the Taihang range, where the Mok River rises; atop it is Huangze Ridge, with the Eighteen Bends patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又東有清漳水，分二流，至東南交漳村而合，南入黎城縣界。

translations.literal: Also east has Qingzhang River, divides two flows, to southeast Jiaozhang village joins, south enters Licheng County border.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east is the Qingzhang River, which divides and rejoins at Jiaozhang village southeast, then flows south into Licheng County.

sentences.zh: 又西北有遼陽水，流合清漳水。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Liaoyang River, flows join Qingzhang River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest the Liaoyang River joins the Qingzhang.

translations.literal: Administered two counties.
translations.idiomatic: It administered two counties.

sentences.zh: 西北距布政司三百四十里。

translations.literal: Northwest distance from provincial commission three hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred forty li northwest of the provincial administration commission.

translations.literal: Yushe zhou west.
translations.idiomatic: Yushe zhou—west [of the prefecture].

translations.literal: West has Yu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Yu River.

translations.literal: Southwest has Wuxiang River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest is the Wuxiang River.

sentences.zh: 又西北有黃花嶺、馬陵關二巡檢司。

translations.literal: Also northwest has Huanghualing, Maling Pass two Patrol Inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest are the Huanghualing and Maling Pass patrol inspectorates.

translations.literal: Heshun zhou north.
translations.idiomatic: Heshun zhou—north [of the prefecture].

sentences.zh: 東有黃榆嶺，北有松子嶺，西有八賦嶺，俱有巡檢司。

translations.literal: East has Huangyu Ridge, north has Songzi Ridge, west has Bafu Ridge, all have Patrol Inspectorates.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Huangyu Ridge; to the north Songzi Ridge; to the west Bafu Ridge—each with a patrol inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 又清漳水在西北，松嶺水及八賦水、樑榆水俱流入焉。

translations.literal: Also Qingzhang River in northwest, Songling River and Bafu River, Liangyu River all flow into it.
translations.idiomatic: The Qingzhang River lies to the northwest; the Songling, Bafu, and Liangyu rivers all flow into it.

sentences.zh: 山西行都指揮使司本大同都衛，洪武四年正月置。

translations.literal: Shanxi Branch Regional Military Commission originally Datong Capital Guard, Hongwu fourth year first month established.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi Branch Regional Military Commission was originally the Datong Capital Guard, established in the first month of Hongwu 4.

translations.literal: Seat at Baiyang walled city.
translations.idiomatic: Its seat was at Baiyang walled city.

translations.literal: Eighth year tenth month renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 8 it was renamed.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月徙治大同府。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year eighth month moved seat to Datong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 25 its seat was moved to Datong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月領衛二十六，宣府左、右，萬全左、右，懷安五衛，改屬萬全都司。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year second month administered twenty-six guards, Xuanfu Left, Right, Wanquan Left, Right, Huai'an five guards, changed subordination to Wanquan Supreme Command.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 26 it administered twenty-six guards—Xuanfu Left and Right, Wanquan Left and Right, and the five Huai'an guards—which were transferred to the Wanquan supreme command.

translations.literal: Later administered fourteen guards.
translations.idiomatic: It later administered fourteen guards.

sentences.zh: 朔州衛治州城，安東中屯衛寄治應州城。

translations.literal: Shuozhou Guard seat at zhou walled city, Andong Central Garrison Guard attached seat at Ying Prefecture walled city.
translations.idiomatic: Shuozhou Guard was seated at the zhou walled city; Andong Central Garrison Guard had its attached seat at Ying Prefecture walled city.

sentences.zh: 大同前衛洪武七年二月置，與行都司同城。

translations.literal: Datong Front Guard Hongwu seventh year second month established, same city as Branch Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Front Guard was established in the second month of Hongwu 7, in the same city as the branch commission.

sentences.zh: 大同後衛洪武二十五年八月置，與行都司同城，尋罷。

translations.literal: Datong Rear Guard Hongwu twenty-fifth year eighth month established, same city as Branch Commission, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Rear Guard was established in the eighth month of Hongwu 25, in the same city as the branch commission, and was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月復置，治行都司東，後仍徙行都司城。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year second month again established, seat east of provincial command, later still moved to provincial command city.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the second month of Hongwu 26, with its seat east of the provincial command, and was later moved back to the provincial command city.

sentences.zh: 東有聚落城，天順三年築。

translations.literal: East has Jiluo Stockade city, Tianshun third year built.
translations.idiomatic: To the east is Jiluo Stockade city, built in Tianshun 3.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年九月置聚落守禦千戶所於此，來屬。

translations.literal: Jiajing second year ninth month established Jiluo garrison-defense thousand-household post here, came to belong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Jiajing 2 the Jiluo garrison-defense thousand-household post was established here and placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 大同中衛洪武二十五年八月置，與行都司同城，後罷。

translations.literal: Datong Central Guard Hongwu twenty-fifth year eighth month established, with provincial command same city, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Central Guard was established in the eighth month of Hongwu 25 in the same city as the provincial command, and was later abolished.

sentences.zh: 天成衛元天成縣，屬興和路。

translations.literal: Tiancheng Guard originally Tiancheng County, belonged to Xinghe Route.
translations.idiomatic: Tiancheng Guard—under the Yuan it was Tiancheng County in Xinghe Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年五月改屬大同府，縣尋廢。

translations.literal: Hongwu fourth year fifth month changed to belong to Datong Prefecture, county soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Hongwu 4 it was placed under Datong Prefecture, and the county was soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月置衛，後徙鎮虜衛來同治。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year second month established guard, later moved Zhenlu Guard to come jointly administer.
translations.idiomatic: A guard was established in the second month of Hongwu 26; later Zhenlu Guard was moved here to share the same seat.

translations.literal: Sanggan River in south.
translations.idiomatic: The Sanggan River lies to the south.

sentences.zh: 南洋河在北，即雁門水也，東入宣府西陽和堡界。

translations.literal: South Yang River in north, that is Yanmen waters also, east enters Xuanfu west Xiyanghe Fort border.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the South Yang River—the Yanmen River—which flows east into the Xiyanghe Fort district on the western border of Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 西南距行都司一百二十里。

translations.literal: Southwest distance from provincial command one hundred twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred twenty li southwest of the provincial command.

sentences.zh: 威遠衛正統三年三月以淨水坪置。

translations.literal: Weiyuan Guard Zhengtong third year third month at Jingshui Flat established.
translations.idiomatic: Weiyuan Guard was established in the third month of Zhengtong 3 at Jingshui Flat.

translations.literal: South has Great South Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the south is Great South Mountain.

translations.literal: West has Little South Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Little South Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又南有南大河，下流入於兔毛川。

translations.literal: Also south has South Great River, lower flow enters Tumao River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south is the South Great River, whose lower course joins the Tumao River.

sentences.zh: 東距行都司一百八十里。

translations.literal: East distance from provincial command one hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies one hundred eighty li east of the provincial command.

sentences.zh: 平虜衛成化十七年置，與行都司同城。

translations.literal: Pinglu Guard Chenghua seventeenth year established, with provincial command same city.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu Guard was established in Chenghua 17 in the same city as the provincial command.

translations.literal: Jiajing period moved to present seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing reign it was moved to its present seat.

sentences.zh: 西有小青山，又有黃河自東勝衛流入。

translations.literal: West has Little Green Mountain, also has Yellow River from Dongsheng Guard flows in.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is Little Green Mountain, and the Yellow River enters from Dongsheng Guard.

translations.literal: North has South Great River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is the South Great River.

sentences.zh: 西北有云內縣，本元雲內州，屬大同路，洪武五年廢。

translations.literal: Northwest has Yunnei County, originally Yuan Yunnei zhou, belonged to Datong Route, Hongwu fifth year abolished.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Yunnei County—under the Yuan it was Yunnei zhou in Datong Route—abolished in Hongwu 5.

sentences.zh: 宣德中復置縣，屬豐州，正統十四年復廢。

translations.literal: Xuande period again established county, belonged to Feng zhou, Zhengtong fourteenth year again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The county was re-established in the Xuande reign and placed under Feng zhou, then abolished again in Zhengtong 14.

sentences.zh: 西北有平地縣，元屬大同路，亦洪武中廢。

translations.literal: Northwest has Pingdi County, Yuan belonged to Datong Route, also abolished in Hongwu period.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest is Pingdi County, which under the Yuan belonged to Datong Route and was also abolished in the Hongwu period.

sentences.zh: 東北距行都司二百四十里。

translations.literal: Northeast distance from provincial command two hundred forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies two hundred forty li northeast of the provincial command.

translations.literal: Commands one thousand-household post:
translations.idiomatic: It commanded one thousand-household post:

sentences.zh: 井坪守禦千戶所成化二十年七月置。

translations.literal: Jingping garrison-defense thousand-household post Chenghua twentieth year seventh month established.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingping garrison-defense thousand-household post was established in the seventh month of Chenghua 20.

sentences.zh: 宣德衛元宣寧縣，屬大同路。

translations.literal: Xuande Guard originally Xuande County, belonged to Datong Route.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande Guard—under the Yuan it was Xuande County in Datong Route.

translations.literal: Hongwu period, county abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu period the county was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月置宣德衛，後廢。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year second month established Xuande Guard, later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande Guard was established in the second month of Hongwu 26, then abolished.

translations.literal: Southeast distance from provincial command eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies eighty li southeast of the provincial command.

sentences.zh: 東勝衛元東勝州，屬大同路。

translations.literal: Dongsheng Guard originally Yuan Dongsheng zhou, belonged to Datong Route.
translations.idiomatic: Dongsheng Guard—under the Yuan it was Dongsheng zhou in Datong Route.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年正月，州廢，置衛。

translations.literal: Hongwu fourth year first month, zhou abolished, established guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Hongwu 4 the zhou was abolished and a guard established.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月分置東勝左、右、中、前、後五衛，屬行都司。

translations.literal: Twenty-fifth year eighth month divided and established Dongsheng Left, Right, Central, Front, Rear five guards, belonged to provincial command.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Hongwu 25 it was split into Dongsheng Left, Right, Central, Front, and Rear guards, all under the provincial command.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月罷中、前、衛三衛。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year second month abolished Central, Front, Rear three guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Hongwu 26 the Central, Front, and Rear guards were abolished.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年二月徙左衛於兆直盧龍縣，右衛於北直遵化縣，直隸後軍都督府。

translations.literal: Yongle first year second month moved Left Guard to Zhaozhi Lulong County, Right Guard to North Zhili Zunhua County, directly subordinated to Rear Army supreme command.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Yongle 1 the Left Guard was moved to Lulong County in North Zhili and the Right Guard to Zunhua County in North Zhili, both placed under the Rear Army supreme command.

sentences.zh: 三月置東勝中、前、後三千戶所於懷仁等處守禦，而衛城遂虛。

translations.literal: Third month established Dongsheng Central, Front, Rear three thousand-household posts at Huairen and other places for garrison defense, and guard city then empty.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Dongsheng Central, Front, and Rear thousand-household posts were established at Huairen and elsewhere for garrison defense, and the guard city was left vacant.

sentences.zh: 正統三年九月復置，後仍廢。

translations.literal: Zhengtong third year ninth month again established, later still abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was re-established in the ninth month of Zhengtong 3, then abolished again.

translations.literal: North has Chi'er Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the north is Chi'er Mountain.

translations.literal: West has Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: To the west is the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 西北有黑河，源出舊豐州之官山，西流入雲內州界，又東經此入於黃河。

translations.literal: Northwest has Black River, source issues from old Feng zhou's Guanshan, west flows into Yunnei zhou border, again east passes here enters Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is the Black River, rising at Guanshan in the old Feng zhou, flowing west into Yunnei zhou and then east through this district into the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又有兔毛川，亦入於黃河。

translations.literal: Also has Tumao River, also enters Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Tumao River, which likewise joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 又有紫河，源出舊豐州西北之黑峪口，下流至雲內州界，入於黑河。

translations.literal: Also has Purple River, source issues from old Feng zhou northwest's Heiyu Pass, lower flow reaches Yunnei zhou border, enters Black River.
translations.idiomatic: There is also the Purple River, rising at Heiyu Pass northwest of the old Feng zhou; its lower course reaches Yunnei zhou and joins the Black River.

sentences.zh: 又西有金河泊，上承紫河，下流亦入於黃河。

translations.literal: Also west has Jinhe Marsh, upper receives Purple River, lower flow also enters Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west is Jinhe Marsh, fed by the Purple River, whose outflow also enters the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 西北有豐州，元屬大同路，洪武中廢，宣德元年復置；

translations.literal: Northwest has Feng zhou, Yuan belonged to Datong Route, abolished in Hongwu period, Xuande first year again established;
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest is Feng zhou, which under the Yuan belonged to Datong Route, was abolished in the Hongwu period, and was re-established in Xuande 1;

translations.literal: Zhengtong period moved inward, again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: in the Zhengtong reign it was moved inland and abolished again.

sentences.zh: 又有淨州路，元直隸中書省，亦洪武中廢。

translations.literal: Also has Jingzhou Route, Yuan directly subordinated to Central Secretariat, also abolished in Hongwu period.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Jingzhou Route, which under the Yuan was directly subordinated to the Central Secretariat and was abolished in the Hongwu period.

translations.literal: West distance from provincial command five hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It lies five hundred li west of the provincial command.

sentences.zh: 領千戶所五：失寶赤千戶所、五花城千戶所、幹魯忽奴千戶所、燕只千戶所、甕吉刺千戶所，俱洪武四年正月置。

translations.literal: Commands five thousand-household posts: Shibaozhi, Wuhuacheng, Ganluhunu, Yanzhi, Wengjila thousand-household posts, all Hongwu fourth year first month established.
translations.idiomatic: It commanded five thousand-household posts—the Shibaozhi, Wuhuacheng, Ganluhunu, Yanzhi, and Wengjila posts—all established in the first month of Hongwu 4.
